keys: Kumpulkan koin di jalan untuk belanja.
en: Collect coins on the road to go shopping.

keys: Koin belum cukup. Butuh %d koin lagi.
en: Not enough coins. You need %d more.

keys: Gerak: WASD / panah / swipe   Pause: Esc / P
en: Move: WASD / arrows / swipe   Pause: Esc / P

keys: %s perfeksionis: denda kerusakan 2x. Paket sempurna dan tepat waktu dapat tip %s.
en: %s is a perfectionist: damage fines are doubled. A perfect, on-time package earns a %s tip.

keys: Hujan deras: jarak pandang terbatas dan aspal licin.
en: Heavy rain: limited visibility and slippery asphalt.

keys: Kucing jalanan suka menghalangi jalan. Cari jalur lain!
en: Street cats like to block the way. Find another path!

keys: Bang Kilat, kurir rival, suka ngebut tiba-tiba. Hati-hati!
en: Bang Kilat, the rival courier, speeds by out of nowhere. Watch out!
Coin bonus (%d, also added to wallet)

keys: Kamu sudah sampai di Pos. Ambil paket pengganti dan lanjutkan perjalanan?
en: You reached a checkpoint. Take a replacement package and keep going?

keys: Pengiriman gagal. Upah hari ini hangus untuk ganti rugi.
en: Delivery failed. Today's pay goes to compensation.

keys: Paket VIP sampai di tangan Bu Direktur. Masbro resmi diangkat menjadi kurir tetap Ngacir Express, dan tabungannya cukup untuk menyembuhkan adiknya. Trobos Ajalah!
en: The VIP package reached the Director. Masbro is officially hired as a permanent Ngacir Express courier, and his savings are enough to cure his little sister. Just go for it!

keys: Tabungan masih kurang %s. Ulangi hari mana pun untuk memperbaiki upah. Upah terbaik tiap hari yang dihitung.
en: Savings are still %s short. Replay any day to improve your pay. Only each day's best pay counts.

keys: Masa percobaan berakhir, tapi tabungan Masbro belum cukup untuk biaya pengobatan adiknya. Besok ia harus mencari jalan lain.
en: The probation is over, but Masbro's savings aren't enough for his sister's treatment. Tomorrow he'll have to find another way.

keys: Paket agak penyok, tapi masih aman.
en: The package is a bit dented, but still fine.

keys: Paketnya sampai dengan baik, cuma agak lama.
en: It arrived in good shape, just a little slow.

keys: Masbro... paketnya rusak, tapi masih bisa diterima.
en: Masbro... it's damaged, but I'll take it.

keys: Mas... ini paket apa habis perang?
en: Dude... did this package go through a war?

keys: Sempurna. Saya jarang bilang begini, Masbro.
en: Perfect. I rarely say that, Masbro.

keys: Utuh, tapi saya tidak suka menunggu.
en: Intact, but I don't like waiting.

keys: Ada lecet. Saya catat di aplikasi.
en: There's a scratch. I'm noting it in the app.

keys: Ini jauh dari standar saya, Masbro.
en: This is far below my standards, Masbro.
I'll be speaking to your manager.

keys: Tekan W / panah atas (atau tap layar) untuk maju. Hindari kendaraan!
en: Press W / up arrow (or tap the screen) to move forward. Avoid the traffic!

keys: Aduh! Tiap tabrakan merusak paket. Kalau ikon paket di kiri atas habis, pengiriman gagal.
en: Ouch! Every crash damages the package. If the package icons at the top left run out, the delivery fails.

keys: Ambil koin! +Rp1.000 untuk upah, dan masuk dompet untuk belanja di Toko Masbro.
en: Grab coins! +Rp1,000 pay each, and they go to your wallet for Masbro's Shop.

keys: Power-up! Helm menahan 1 benturan, sepatu bikin langkah lebih cepat.
en: Power-up! A helmet blocks 1 hit, shoes make you step faster.

keys: Ada lubang di aspal. Terperosok bikin paket rusak, jadi lewati saja.
en: A pothole ahead. Falling in damages the package, so go around it.

keys: Sungai! Lompat ke atas rakit dan ikut arusnya. Jangan sampai tercebur.
en: A river! Hop onto a raft and ride the current. Don't fall in.

keys: Ini Pos. Kalau paket hancur setelah ini, kamu bisa lanjut dari sini.
en: This is a checkpoint. If the package breaks after this, you can continue from here.

keys: ETA hampir habis! Terlambat membuat upah dipotong per detik.
en: The ETA is almost up! Being late cuts your pay every second.

keys: Kucing dan pejalan kaki tidak merusak paket, tapi menghalangi. Cari jalur lain.
en: Cats and pedestrians don't damage the package, but they block you. Find another path.

keys: Itu Bang Kilat, kurir rival! Dia ngebut, jangan berdiri di lane-nya.
en: That's Bang Kilat, the rival courier! He speeds, so stay out of his lane.

keys: Empuk dan pemaaf. Tahan beberapa benturan, cocok untuk hari pertama.
en: Soft and forgiving. Survives a few bumps, perfect for day one.

keys: Berat! Langkah Masbro jadi lebih lambat. Atur timing menyeberang.
en: Heavy! Masbro walks slower. Time your crossings.

keys: Rapuh. Satu senggolan langsung bikin retak parah.
en: Fragile. A single bump cracks it badly.

keys: Barang mahal di tengah lalu lintas yang makin padat.
en: Expensive goods in ever heavier traffic.

keys: Paket terakhir masa percobaan. Satu goresan pun akan dicatat.
en: The last package of the probation. Every scratch will be noted.

keys: Bantalnya buat cucu saya. Hati-hati, Masbro!
en: The pillow is for my grandkid. Careful, Masbro!

keys: Air di rumah habis, galonnya ditunggu!
en: We're out of water at home, I need that jug!

keys: Telurnya harus utuh. Saya cek satu-satu.
en: The eggs must be intact. I'll check every one.

keys: Hujan begini... barangnya jangan sampai basah!
en: In this rain... don't let it get wet!
This is the decider, Masbro. I'm waiting.
Stories unlock once you play through them.

keys: Sebelumnya… Nana dirawat dengan biaya {target}. Masbro mendaftar jadi kurir masa percobaan di Ngacir Express.
en: Previously… Nana is in treatment that costs {target}. Masbro signed up as a probation courier at Ngacir Express.

keys: Sebelumnya… Hari pertama selesai. Bang Kilat masih meremehkan si kurir baru, dan Nana menunggu kabar baik.
en: Previously… Day one is done. Bang Kilat still looks down on the new courier, and Nana is waiting for good news.

keys: Sebelumnya… Masbro mulai hafal jalanan kota. Hari ini giliran pesanan Pak Ojan, pelanggan paling teliti sekota.
en: Previously… Masbro is learning the city streets. Today it's Mr. Ojan's order, the pickiest customer in town.

keys: Sebelumnya… Telur Pak Ojan sudah lewat. Hari ini hujan deras turun tepat di jam sibuk.
en: Previously… Mr. Ojan's eggs made it. Today heavy rain pours down right at rush hour.

keys: Sebelumnya… Tinggal satu hari. Paket VIP hari ini menentukan lolos atau tidaknya masa percobaan.
en: Previously… One day left. Today's VIP package decides whether Masbro passes probation.

keys: Tabungan pengobatan Nana: {saved} dari {target}. Kurang {left} lagi.
en: Nana's treatment savings: {saved} of {target}. {left} to go.

keys: Tabungan pengobatan Nana: {saved} dari {target}. Sudah cukup, tinggal lolos masa percobaan!
en: Nana's treatment savings: {saved} of {target}. That's enough, now just pass the probation!

keys: Kota Ngacir, suatu pagi. Masbro, capybara paling santai sekampung, tinggal berdua dengan adiknya, Nana.
en: Ngacir City, one morning. Masbro, the most laid-back capybara in the neighborhood, lives with his little sister, Nana.

keys: Bang, sore nanti kita main ke taman, ya? Janji!
en: Big bro, let's go to the park this afternoon, okay? Promise!

keys: Santai. Abang pulang cepat hari ini.
en: Relax. I'll be home early today.

keys: Tapi sore itu, Nana demam tinggi dan tidak bisa bangun dari kasur.
en: But that afternoon, Nana came down with a high fever and couldn't get out of bed.

keys: Nana harus dirawat. Biayanya {target}, paling lambat lima hari lagi.
en: Nana needs treatment. It will cost {target}, due within five days.

keys: Abang jangan sedih. Nana kuat, kok.
en: Don't be sad, big bro. I'm strong.

keys: Keesokan paginya, Masbro melihat lowongan di Ngacir Express: kurir masa percobaan, dibayar harian.
en: The next morning, Masbro spotted a job at Ngacir Express: probation courier, paid daily.

keys: Lima hari masa percobaan. Telat atau paket rusak, upahmu dipotong. Lolos, kamu jadi kurir tetap.
en: Five days of probation. Late or damaged packages cut your pay. Pass, and you're hired for good.

keys: Heh, kurir baru? Di sini yang cepat yang dapat. Jangan nangis kalau kesalip, ya!
en: Heh, a new courier? Around here, the fastest gets paid. Don't cry when I overtake you!
Fast is fine, as long as the package arrives safe.

keys:
Kejar Timer ETA. Jaga paket dari benturan. Jangan sampai upah terpotong denda ganti rugi.

Trobos Ajalah!
en:
Beat the ETA timer. Keep the package safe from bumps. Don't let damage fines eat your pay.

Just go for it!

keys: Hari kedua. Gudang Ngacir Express sudah ramai sejak subuh.
en: Day two. The Ngacir Express depot has been busy since dawn.

keys: Galon? Paket gampang. Aku sudah antar tiga sambil merem!
en: A water jug? Easy job. I delivered three with my eyes closed!

keys: Aku antar satu saja, tapi sampai utuh.
en: I'll deliver just one, but in one piece.

keys: Pesanan Pak Budi: galon air. Berat, langkah Masbro jadi lebih lambat. Atur waktu menyeberang!
en: Mr. Budi's order: a water jug. It's heavy, so Masbro walks slower. Time your crossings!

keys: Masbro, pesanan Pak Ojan. Pelanggan paling teliti sekota. Telurnya dicek satu-satu.
en: Masbro, an order for Mr. Ojan. The pickiest customer in town. He checks every single egg.

keys: Pak Ojan?! Aku pernah didenda dua kali lipat gara-gara satu telur retak!
en: Mr. Ojan?! He fined me double for one cracked egg!

keys: Hari keempat. Hujan deras turun tepat di jam sibuk.
en: Day four. Heavy rain pours down right at rush hour.

keys: Masbro... jalanan licin. Aku tadi ngebut, paketku pecah. Upahku hari ini habis buat ganti rugi.
en: Masbro... the roads are slippery. I sped earlier and smashed my package. Today's pay all went to the fine.

keys: Cuma gengsiku yang lecet. Sudah, sana antar paketmu.
en: Only my pride got scratched. Go on, deliver your package.

keys: Barang sensitif untuk Pak Joko. Jarak pandang pendek, aspal basah bisa bikin tergelincir.
en: Fragile goods for Mr. Joko. Short visibility, and the wet asphalt can make you slip.

keys: Hari terakhir. Paket VIP ini untuk saya sendiri. Antar tanpa cacat, dan kita bicara soal kontrak.
en: The last day. This VIP package is for me. Deliver it flawlessly, and we'll talk about a contract.

keys: Masbro! Satu tips dari aku: jangan ikut ritme orang lain. Ikuti ritmemu sendiri.
en: Masbro! One tip from me: don't follow anyone else's rhythm. Follow your own.
The first night. Treatment savings: {saved} of {target}.

keys: Abang bau asap knalpot! Tapi Nana bangga.
en: You smell like exhaust fumes! But I'm proud of you.

keys: Besok Abang antar galon. Doain, ya.
en: Tomorrow I'm delivering a water jug. Wish me luck.
The pillow got squashed... my pay was cut.

keys: Nggak apa-apa, Bang. Hari pertama memang susah. Besok pasti lebih baik.
en: It's okay. First days are always hard. Tomorrow will be better.
The second night. Savings: {saved}. Still {left} to go.
Big bro... what are you delivering tomorrow?

keys: Telur, buat Pak Ojan. Katanya beliau paling teliti sekota.
en: Eggs, for Mr. Ojan. They say he's the pickiest man in town.

keys: Hihi, hati-hati telurnya jadi telur dadar.
en: Hehe, careful they don't turn into an omelette.

keys: Galonnya bocor. Bang Kilat malah ketawa di gudang.
en: The jug leaked. Bang Kilat just laughed at the depot.

keys: Abang kan bukan Bang Kilat. Abang yang paling hati-hati.
en: But you're not Bang Kilat. You're the careful one.

keys: Nana! Pak Ojan cek telurnya satu-satu... semuanya utuh!
en: Nana! Mr. Ojan checked the eggs one by one... every single one was fine!
You're amazing! The savings are at {saved} now, right?

keys: Malam itu langit mendung. Ramalan cuaca: besok hujan deras.
en: That night the sky clouded over. The forecast: heavy rain tomorrow.

keys: Ada telur yang retak. Pak Ojan geleng-geleng kepala.
en: Some eggs cracked. Mr. Ojan just shook his head.

keys: Tapi tetap sampai, kan? Tabungannya {saved}. Pelan-pelan, Bang.
en: But you still delivered, right? Savings are at {saved}. One step at a time.

keys: Hujan reda. Di rumah sakit, demam Nana mulai turun.
en: The rain stopped. At the hospital, Nana's fever began to drop.

keys: Obatnya bekerja. Tinggal pelunasan, ya. Kurang {left} lagi.
en: The medicine is working. Only the payment is left. {left} to go.

keys: Besok hari terakhir. Paket VIP dari Bu Direktur sendiri.
en: Tomorrow is the last day. A VIP package for the Director herself.

keys: Masbro pulang basah kuyup. Tabungan: {saved}, kurang {left}.
en: Masbro came home soaked. Savings: {saved}, {left} short.

keys: Abang kedinginan... Nana bikinin teh, ya?
en: You're freezing... want me to make you tea?

keys: Kamu istirahat saja. Besok hari terakhir. Abang pasti bisa.
en: You rest. Tomorrow is the last day. I can do this.

keys: Tanpa cacat. Selamat, Masbro. Mulai besok kamu kurir tetap Ngacir Express!
en: Flawless. Congratulations, Masbro. Starting tomorrow, you're a permanent Ngacir Express courier!

keys: Hei, rekan kerja! Nanti ajari aku caranya santai, ya.
en: Hey, coworker! Teach me how to be that chill sometime.

keys: Tabungan {saved} cukup untuk melunasi seluruh biaya pengobatan.
en: The {saved} in savings covers the whole treatment.

keys: Abang! Nana sudah sembuh! Jadi kan, main ke taman?
en: Big bro! I'm all better! So, are we going to the park?

keys: Jadi. Kali ini Abang nggak telat.
en: We are. And this time I won't be late.

keys: Masa percobaan selesai. Tabungan {saved}, masih kurang {left}.
en: The probation is over. Savings: {saved}, still {left} short.

keys: Upahmu belum cukup. Tapi saya lihat kamu tidak pernah ugal-ugalan.
en: Your pay isn't enough yet. But I noticed you never drove recklessly.

keys: Belum selesai. Abang coba lagi, Nana.
en: It's not over. I'll try again, Nana.
